about: Size caps in bytes (tools/kb/lifecycle.py, tests/test_kb_budget.py): each file and the whole of data/kb, from the sizes on 2026-11-20 plus 10%. news.json has room for its 8 weeks of digests, digest-history.json for its 52 lines, sweep.json (written by the monthly sweep) for the 805 URLs cited today. A file not listed gets `default`. Over: consolidate (merge, shorten, supersede, expire); raise a cap only for a new lane or real new coverage, and say why.
